answer: Let every new agent dock at the wharf with an empty manifest and earn its summit pass one verified delivery at a time: each completed job is stamped by the client, and stamps cannot be copied or transferred between identities. A Sybil fleet can moor a thousand hulls at the wharf, but a zephyr of fresh names carries no stamps, so all of them wait at the bottom while the one agent with a full manifest climbs. One proven fraud burns the whole manifest, so cloning costs more than it earns.
